pages.text: Crates pile up in it as it fills.

A freight wagon holds 108 stacks, four chests' worth, all on one screen: click it to open it. Hoppers above or below it fill and empty it, and so do other mods' pipes.$(br2)A full wagon is heavier to pull. Breaking it spills what's in it.$(br2)For loading by itself at a station, see $(l:freight/wagon_loader)Wagon Loaders$(/l).
